blueprints.name: Business Owner
blueprints.subtitle: You are showing strong signs of an entrepreneurial mindset. Rather than simply looking for another job, you may be a strong fit for building something of your own.
blueprints.why_this_blueprint: Based on your answers, you value independence, flexibility, and the opportunity to control your own income. Locksmithing can provide a practical path to building a local service business that grows with your skill, reliability, and customer base.
blueprints.study_pace: Recommended study pace: 8–12 hours per week.
blueprints.timeline: Estimated timeline: 3–6 months to complete the core training path, depending on consistency and available study time.
blueprints.revenue_potential: Revenue potential example: Many locksmith services are valuable because they solve urgent local problems. For examples on this page, use $220 as the average service value. Do not present this as a guarantee.
blueprints.next_milestone: Next milestone: Complete the core training path, prepare basic tools, and begin planning how to win your first local customers.
blueprints.cta_helper_text: Build the skills, confidence, and practical foundation to move toward your own locksmith business.

blueprints.name: Career Change
blueprints.subtitle: You appear ready for a new professional direction. This path is designed for someone who wants to move into a practical, respected trade.
blueprints.why_this_blueprint: Your answers suggest you are looking for a fresh start, better long-term opportunity, and a skill set that can translate into real work. Locksmithing combines hands-on technical training with practical local demand.
blueprints.study_pace: Recommended study pace: 6–10 hours per week.
blueprints.timeline: Estimated timeline: 4–7 months to complete the core training path, depending on your schedule and pace.
blueprints.revenue_potential: Revenue potential example: Locksmithing can lead to employment, independent work, or specialized services. Use $220 as the average service value in examples, while avoiding guaranteed-income claims.
blueprints.next_milestone: Next milestone: Complete the training path, earn your certificate, and prepare for entry-level opportunities or first paid work.
blueprints.cta_helper_text: Begin building a practical trade skill that can support your next chapter.

blueprints.name: Side Income
blueprints.subtitle: You may not need to replace your current job immediately. Your answers suggest that locksmithing could fit as a flexible second-income path.
blueprints.why_this_blueprint: You seem interested in increasing your income while keeping your current obligations. Locksmithing can be learned gradually and may support weekend, evening, or part-time opportunities as your skill grows.
blueprints.study_pace: Recommended study pace: 3–6 hours per week.
blueprints.timeline: Estimated timeline: 5–8 months to complete the core training path at a lighter weekly pace.
blueprints.revenue_potential: Revenue potential example: Even a small number of service opportunities can create meaningful supplemental income. Use $220 as the average service value in examples, without promising specific earnings.
blueprints.next_milestone: Next milestone: Complete the training path and identify small, realistic ways to begin applying the skill safely and professionally.
blueprints.cta_helper_text: Learn a practical skill at a manageable pace while keeping your current life stable.

blueprints.name: Employment
blueprints.subtitle: Your answers point toward a stable professional path. This blueprint focuses on becoming employable in a practical skilled trade.
blueprints.why_this_blueprint: You appear to value structure, dependability, and a clear professional route. Locksmithing can support employment with locksmith companies, security providers, institutions, and other organizations that need trained technicians.
blueprints.study_pace: Recommended study pace: 5–8 hours per week.
blueprints.timeline: Estimated timeline: 4–6 months to complete the core training path, depending on pace and consistency.
blueprints.revenue_potential: Revenue potential example: Locksmith training can support paid employment or future independent work. Use $220 as the average service value only when showing service examples; do not imply guaranteed earnings.
blueprints.next_milestone: Next milestone: Complete the training path, earn your certificate, and prepare for interviews or supervised entry-level opportunities.
blueprints.cta_helper_text: Build a practical skill set that can support stable employment and long-term professional growth.

overlays.name: Fast Track
overlays.module_title: You may be ready to move faster.
overlays.module_body: Your answers suggest that you have both motivation and enough weekly availability to progress faster than many students. If you keep a steady schedule, you may be able to complete the program on an accelerated timeline.
overlays.global_effect: Adds badge near match score; moves timeline block higher; uses accelerated pace language; reduces estimated timeline by roughly 20–30%; keeps all income language non-guaranteed.

rule_engine.Rule / Specification: Sum BUSINESS, CAREER_CHANGE, SIDE_INCOME and EMPLOYMENT across all selected answers. The highest total becomes the Primary Blueprint.
If two or more blueprints tie, choose the tied blueprint that was affected by the most recent selected answer.
If still tied, use this order: Business Owner > Career Change > Side Income > Employment.
Apply when FAST_TRACK score is 8 or higher. This is an overlay, not a blueprint. It modifies the selected blueprint.
Apply when CONFIDENCE score is 8 or higher. This is an overlay, not a blueprint. It modifies tone and adds reassurance copy.
Sum INCOME, OWNERSHIP, SECURITY, FAMILY, FRESH_START and MOMENTUM. Highest theme controls the primary emotional framing.
If themes tie, choose the theme most recently affected by an answer. If still tied: INCOME > OWNERSHIP > SECURITY > FRESH_START > FAMILY > MOMENTUM.
Use average service value of $220. Avoid guaranteed income claims.
If a user response cannot be mapped, mark Requires Business Logic rather than guessing in production.
